messages:
Nina Park: quick postmortem follow-up from today's mini game-day. Captured a few repeat items we should triage into short sprints.
Arjun Patel: quick list from my side: 1) multi-region routing stalls when control-plane updates overlap with DNS TTL swaps 2) occasional snapshot replication misses for small buckets 3) unclear acceptance criteria on post-restore validation checks
Sam Conway: saw the same. For the routing case, the control-plane applied two conflicting route policies within 30s which caused ephemeral blackholes. Suggest adding a traffic-hold step during policy rollouts.
Lia Gomez: I'll take ownership for runbook acceptance criteria. Plan: add explicit success signals, exact curl/check commands, and a recovery timer. Draft by Fri EOD.
Arjun Patel: I'll own the routing mitigation: implement a hold-and-drain step and a canary rollout. Testing plan: 3 flaps with load generator in eu-west then us-east. ETA results in 48h.
Nina Park: can we also add a small automation to detect missing cross-region snapshot copies? we had ~5 snapshots without the replication tag.
Sam Conway: I can write a quick verifier: outputs CSV of snapshot_id, source_region, copies_present. Will add `--fix` flag to queue copy jobs. ETA: tomorrow morning.
OpsBot: Jira created: RINF-2421 "DR: routing hold + snapshot verifier" by Nina Park.
Lia Gomez: runbook changes I'm planning: - pre-cutover checklist (monitoring & expected steady-state) - DNS cutover steps with exact TTL math - replica resync SQL + expected lag thresholds - validation commands for traffic and DB sync
Arjun Patel: routing snippet prototype (nginx lua) below for brief hold logic:
```
-- lua pseudo
if upstream_health < 80 then
  weight = 10 -- shift traffic away
else
  weight = 100
end
```
I'll post real config in PR.
Sam Conway: verifier prototype: `tools/snap-crosscheck.py --region eu-west --out missing.csv --fix` will produce CSV and a dry-run plan.
Nina Park: excellent. priorities and owners recap: Arjun = routing hold + canary (48h), Sam = snapshot verifier & repair (tomorrow), Lia = runbook acceptance criteria (Fri EOD), Nina = tracking + linking tickets. I'll keep weekly check-ins until closed.
OpsBot: Reminder: oncall rota: @Arjun Patel starts in 36 hours.
Arjun Patel: ack. need access to `canary-eu-west` test pool. @Nina Park can you grant?
Nina Park: granted. Arjun now has access to `canary-eu-west`.
Lia Gomez: opened runbook PR: https://git.redwood/playbooks/dr/pull/102 — includes template for validation commands.
Sam Conway: PR for verifier: https://git.redwood/infra/snap-tools/pull/9 — feedback welcome.
Arjun Patel: I'll schedule the canary and post results in this thread. If the hold reduces blackholes under load, we'll roll into playbook and dashboard alert.
Nina Park: request: add metric `dr_route_policy_overlap_count` to Grafana so we can detect overlapping policy events. Owner: Lia. ETA: next Wed.
Lia Gomez: will add it and wire up an annotation for game-days.
Nina Park: timeline recap: verifier by +1 day, routing canary + results by +2 days, runbook final by +5 days, dashboards + metric by +7 days. Please update Jira tickets when you start work. :thumbsup:
